rationale: Three chunky bars with gentle taper — bold and clean, maximises legibility at 16px favicon size
Six fine bars with compact spacing — layered-record richness, good for social-card context at larger sizes
Four balanced steps with slight rounding — reads clearly as a staircase / billing-interval progression at all sizes
Five sharp-cornered steps — crisp timeline-tick geometry, strong technical character with no softening
Three wide rounded steps — bold and approachable, maximises legibility at 16px favicon with chunky proportions
Six fine steps — dense interval grid, signals precision billing cadence; best at medium/large sizes
Three arcs with staggered rotation — layered state-transition rings with balanced spread; legible at both favicon and social-card sizes
Two concentric wide arcs with no offset — minimal and bold, strong favicon silhouette; sweep communicates progress/completion
Three wide arcs with generous radii spread and slight rotation — open, confident mark expressing sustained state transitions
cc echoed layers: the double-c pair gains a shifted shadow echo — depth-through-layering signals the ledger/audit metaphor
all three motifs combined: cc echo + stepped e crossbar + u filling interval — maximum brand-motif density in a single typemark
